description: This Java class handles configuration related to Kafka bootstrap servers within a messaging connectivity context. It manages validation, merging, and application of bootstrap server settings for Kafka connections, ensuring they adhere to specific patterns and are correctly configured.

classes.name: KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig
classes.description: A singleton class that manages Kafka bootstrap server configuration, including validation, merging, and application to Kafka producer properties.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KafkaBootstrapServerSpecificConfig.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating this configuration is applicable for any connection.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the bootstrap server configuration within a connection; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the bootstrap server configuration in a connection is valid based on pattern and content.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the bootstrap server configuration to the provided producer properties map, merging URI and specific config servers.

methods.name: getBootstrapServersFromSpecificConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the bootstrap servers list from the connection's specific configuration.

methods.name: mergeAdditionalBootstrapServers
methods.description: Merges the bootstrap servers from the URI and additional config into a single comma-separated string.

methods.name: getBootstrapServerFromUri
methods.description: Constructs the bootstrap server string from connection hostname and port.
